validation_scope: All 41 newly matching src/worldmap/scene functions are locally verified against A2DE with equal function sizes, complete relocation-normalized ARM instructions, and equal explicit RELA offsets/types/symbol names/addends. Public CI recompiles the same source and reproduces the aggregate fingerprint; no ROM or extracted original game binaries are published.
commit_message:
decomp: recover 41 worldmap scene helpers (A2DE 4.401809%)

Recover 41 exact functions in src/worldmap/scene, including world/path/node
queries, completion and star-coin accounting helpers, input sequence support,
world transition helpers, and five WorldmapScene options-menu dispatch methods.
Canonicalize WM::worlds and Game::getPlayerPowerup symbols plus the affected
relocation addends so strict ARM/reference verification uses the recovered names.

Add 2,080 matching code bytes and 41 matching functions over f42a292.
Totals: 126,616 / 2,876,454 code bytes and 1,506 / 15,667 functions.
Matching data remains 4,276 / 851,344 and no previous match is lost.
The worldmap scene unit now has 2,080 / 15,256 matching code bytes and
41 / 69 matching functions. Fuzzy-only candidates were excluded.

All 41 functions pass local full ARM instruction and explicit relocation
offset/type/name/addend comparison against A2DE. Public CI recompiles the
same sources and reproduces the batch fingerprint before publishing.
No ROM or extracted original game binaries are included.
